cards.key: Austin Reaves is out, so Sandro Mamukelashvili and Collin Sexton and Luka Doncic should play more than usual.
Dennis Schroder is out, so Coby White and Sion James and Christian Anderson should play more than usual.
Lauri Markkanen and Jaren Jackson Jr. are out, so Darryn Peterson and Kyle Filipowski and Josh Green should play more than usual.
Kyrie Irving and Santi Aldama are out, so Daniel Gafford and Walter Clayton Jr. and Marcus Sasser should play more than usual.
Kawhi Leonard is out, so Jamal Shead and Trayce Jackson-Davis should play more than usual.
Fred VanVleet and Clint Capela are out, so Reed Sheppard and Amen Thompson and Bogdan Bogdanovic should play more than usual.
Ryan Rollins and Ousmane Dieng are out, so Brayden Burries and AJ Green should play more than usual.
Jalen Williams and Chet Holmgren are out, so Bennett Stirtz and Jared McCain and Isaiah Hartenstein should play more than usual.

outs.note: Lauri Markkanen has not played since November 6, and the projections list a right hand fracture. The show said Utah being without Markkanen may make Keyonte George harder to buy low on because his role grows.
Jaren Jackson Jr. is ruled out for Utah with a right MCL tear. The show said Utah's defense suffers without him and that Utah looks like it is back in tanking mode.

Jaxson Hayes started on November 13 but played only 13 minutes and left with left knee soreness. The show said Hayes had been the preferred fill-in at center with Jusuf Nurkic and Jaren Jackson Jr. out, and that Mo Bamba is next in line if Hayes misses time.
Fred VanVleet is ruled out Sunday at Washington on the first night of a back-to-back, with Marcus Smart still suspended. Reed Sheppard is the guard in line for more minutes.
Capela started on Oct. 30 with Alperen Sengun and Steven Adams out, but he is now out himself. He missed Nov. 2 with a right ankle sprain.
The show said Justin Champagnie has a broken foot and should return around the All-Star break, and he has not played since Oct. 26.

Kingston Flemings left the November 13 game after 17 minutes with back tightness, which the show said was called a lumbar sprain. The show said to monitor it because back injuries can be tricky, and that CJ McCollum starts if Flemings misses time.

injuries.text: The show said Caleb Wilson broke his hand and is set to miss at least four to six weeks. He played 15 minutes on November 11, the game he was hurt, and has not played since. The show said Chicago's rotation will change while he is out.
GG Jackson left Saturday's game against Brooklyn with a left foot injury after three minutes and did not return.
Jaylen Clark left Saturday's game against Chicago with a right hamstring injury after three minutes and did not return.
The show listed Precious Achiuwa as questionable for Sunday; he missed the November 13 game after leaving November 10 with a lower-leg contusion. The show said Maxime Raynaud remains out.
